title: E-commerce Team Leader – Amazon & Flipkart
description:
E\-commerce Team Leader – Amazon \& Flipkart

**Company:** Value for Sellers  
**Location:** Noida Sector 5  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office Only  
**Experience:** 2–8 Years overall E\-commerce experience \| **2–3\+ Years Team Handling Experience Mandatory**  
**Salary:** ₹24,000 – ₹28,700 per month  
**Department:** E\-commerce Sales

About the Role

Value for Sellers is looking for a **confident, responsible and result\-oriented E\-commerce Team Leader** who can independently manage a team of E\-commerce Executives/Account Managers and drive the performance of **Amazon \& Flipkart marketplace accounts**.

This role is ideal for someone who has strong hands\-on marketplace knowledge and, most importantly, has **2–3\+ years of experience managing, mentoring and driving a team**.

You will be responsible for **team productivity, marketplace performance, sales growth, account health, inventory coordination, catalogue management, reporting and escalations**.

If you enjoy taking ownership, solving marketplace challenges and getting your team to achieve targets, **we'd love to hear from you!** 

Key Responsibilities Team Handling \& Leadership

* Lead, manage and mentor a team of E\-commerce Executives/Account Managers.
* Allocate daily/weekly tasks and ensure timely completion.
* Set team targets/KPIs and regularly monitor individual \& team performance.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and feedback.
* Identify performance gaps and take corrective actions wherever required.
* Ensure smooth coordination between the E\-commerce, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Warehouse and Supply Chain teams.
* Take ownership of the team's overall productivity and marketplace performance.

Amazon \& Flipkart Account Management

* Manage and supervise day\-to\-day operations of multiple Amazon \& Flipkart seller accounts.
* Monitor **account health, order performance, cancellations, returns, seller ratings and policy compliance**.
* Handle marketplace escalations and coordinate with Amazon/Flipkart support teams for issue resolution.
* Ensure all marketplace activities are completed accurately and within timelines.

Sales \& Business Growth

* Drive monthly sales targets and marketplace revenue growth.
* Develop strategies for improving **sales, conversion, visibility and profitability**.
* Identify opportunities through pricing, promotions, product expansion and category growth.
* Monitor sales trends and take corrective actions to improve account performance.
* Track team\-wise and account\-wise targets and ensure timely achievement.

Catalogue \& Listing Management

* Supervise product listing creation, optimisation and maintenance.
* Ensure titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, images and other content are marketplace compliant and SEO\-friendly.
* Monitor catalogue issues, suppressed listings and product content errors.
* Ensure effective utilisation of **A\+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content**, wherever applicable.

Inventory \& Operations

* Monitor inventory levels across marketplaces.
* Coordinate with warehouse/procurement teams to prevent **stock\-outs and overstocking**.
* Track orders, cancellations, returns and fulfilment\-related issues.
* Plan inventory based on sales trends, seasonality and upcoming campaigns.

MIS, Analytics \& Reporting

* Analyse sales, orders, revenue, returns, customer behaviour and marketplace performance.
* Track account\-wise and team\-wise KPIs.
* Prepare and maintain regular **MIS reports, performance dashboards and business reports**.
* Present key insights and actionable recommendations to senior management.
* Identify trends, problems and opportunities through data analysis.

Advertising \& Promotions

* Monitor Amazon Ads and Flipkart Ads performance.
* Coordinate with the advertising/marketing team for campaign planning and optimisation.
* Monitor advertising spend, **ROAS, ROI, ACOS/TACOS** and overall campaign performance.
* Plan and monitor marketplace promotions, deals and seasonal campaigns.

Customer Experience \& Account Health

* Monitor customer ratings, reviews, feedback and complaints.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer\-related marketplace issues.
* Take necessary actions to maintain strong account health and seller performance.

Process \& SOP Management

* Develop and maintain SOPs for day\-to\-day marketplace operations.
* Improve team productivity through better processes and task tracking.
* Stay updated with Amazon \& Flipkart policies, marketplace updates and industry trends.
* Ensure proper documentation and process compliance within the team.

What We Are Looking ForMandatory Requirements

* **2–8 years of experience in E\-commerce/Marketplace Management.**
* **Minimum 2–3 years of proven team\-handling/Team Leader experience is mandatory.**
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Amazon Seller Central \& Flipkart Seller Hub**.
* Experience managing multiple marketplace accounts/products.
* Proven experience in achieving sales and performance targets.
* Good understanding of marketplace operations, catalogue, inventory, orders, returns and account health.
* Working knowledge of marketplace advertising and promotions.
* Strong Excel/MIS and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently handle a team and take ownership of results.

Candidates with experience in:

**Amazon \+ Flipkart \+ Team Handling \+ Sales Target Achievement \+ Marketplace Ads \+ MIS/Reporting** will be preferred.

Important: This is a Work From Office role in Noida Sector 5\. Candidates looking for Work From Home/Hybrid opportunities should not apply.

About Value for Sellers**: Value for Sellers**, based in Noida and operating PAN India since 2016, is a dedicated **channel sales partner** helping brands and businesses grow in the dynamic world of online retail.

We provide end\-to\-end e\-commerce solutions including:

* Amazon, Flipkart \& Meesho Marketplace Management
* Product Catalogue Management
* Professional Product Photography \& Photoshoots
* Sales \& Marketplace Optimisation
* Order \& Inventory Management
* Digital Growth \& Marketplace Strategy

With **7\+ years of industry expertise and a PAN India photoshoot network**, we help brands simplify e\-commerce, improve marketplace performance and turn products into bestsellers.

**Website:** www.valueforsellers.com

If you have strong **Amazon \& Flipkart marketplace experience**, enjoy **leading teams**, and are ready to take ownership of marketplace growth and performance, Please share your CV @**9999857563(WhatsApp Only)**.

**Apply now and join Value for Sellers!**

title: UGC Content Creator
description:

Compensation: ₹15,000 \- ₹25,000/month

About HavStrategy

HavStrategy is a data\-driven digital marketing and performance growth agency serving D2C, ecommerce, fashion, lifestyle, beauty and luxury brands. We combine creativity with analytics to deliver measurable results.

Role Overview

We're hiring a UGC Content Creator to produce authentic, creator\-style videos and photos that look native to social platforms and drive conversions. You'll appear on camera or create faceless content, demonstrate products, and deliver ad\-ready UGC for our client brands' organic and paid campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

Create UGC\-style videos (unboxings, product demos, reviews, GRWM, testimonials, problem\-solution formats) for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Meta ads

Write or adapt scripts, hooks and CTAs that match each brand's tone and campaign goal

Shoot and edit high\-quality vertical content using a smartphone, with good lighting and clear audio

Follow creative briefs and brand guidelines while keeping the content natural and authentic

Coordinate with the social media, design and performance teams on content requirements and timelines

Research trending audios, formats, and competitor and creator content for fresh ideas

Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revisions within deadlines

Review basic performance data (views, watch time, CTR, engagement) and suggest improvements

Requirements

1\-2 years of experience creating UGC, short\-form video or influencer\-style content (portfolio required)

Comfortable on camera, with clear delivery and natural expressions

Good understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and ad creative formats

Basic video editing skills using CapCut, InShot, VN or similar apps

Own smartphone with a good camera, plus basic lighting and a mic

Ability to adapt tone across brands, from playful D2C to premium luxury

Reliability on deadlines and comfort working in a fast\-paced environment

Core Skills Needed

Content \& Creative Skills

UGC video creation (reviews, demos, testimonials, unboxings)

Hook writing and short\-form scripting

On\-camera presence and voiceovers

Product styling and basic photography

Storytelling for ads and organic content

Tools \& Technical Skills

CapCut, InShot, VN or Adobe Premiere Rush

Canva (basic)

Instagram, Meta Business Suite and YouTube Studio

Basic lighting, framing and audio setup

Google Drive / Sheets for file delivery and tracking

Industry/Domain Knowledge

Awareness of current social trends, sounds and formats

Understanding of what makes UGC convert in paid ads

Exposure to beauty, fashion, lifestyle and D2C brand communication (preferred)

Soft Skills

Creativity and confidence

Attention to detail

Time management and ownership

Openness to feedback and collaboration

Preferred Skills

Experience creating UGC for paid ad campaigns

Basic knowledge of content analytics and A/B testing creatives

Prior work with beauty, fashion or D2C brands

Existing audience or creator profile (nice to have, not mandatory)

How to Apply

Send your CV along with 3\-5 UGC samples or links (Reels, ad creatives, product videos, testimonials) and your Instagram or portfolio link.

* **Exposure to hyperscaler ecosystems and AI service stacks, with understanding of scalable deployment and integration patterns.**


* **Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional execution, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment in complex delivery environments.**

**Other Requirements**

* Drive predictable execution of AI product features through structured planning, milestone tracking, and disciplined delivery.

* Strengthen adoption and business impact by aligning releases with GTM readiness and stakeholder needs.
* Enhance visibility and control through metric\-driven tracking of progress, quality, and outcomes **.**

About VibeCrafts

**VibeCrafts** is a growing e\-commerce brand specializing in **home décor, furniture, paintings, mirrors, lighting, wall décor and lifestyle products**.

We are looking for an experienced **E\-Commerce Manager** who can independently manage and grow our marketplace business across multiple platforms and take ownership of day\-to\-day e\-commerce operations, sales, advertising, inventory, catalogue, orders, returns and reporting.

Key Responsibilities**E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Management**

* Take **end\-to\-end ownership of e\-commerce operations** across multiple marketplaces.
* Independently manage **Amazon and Flipkart seller panels**.
* Experience with **Meesho, Shopify and other marketplaces** is required/preferred.
* Manage **Amazon.com / Global marketplaces and Etsy** wherever applicable.
* Monitor marketplace performance, account health, orders, inventory and operational issues.
* Develop and implement processes to improve marketplace operations and sales.

**Product Listing \& Catalogue Management**

* Manage complete **product listing and catalogue operations** across marketplaces.
* Ensure accurate product titles, descriptions, images, attributes, keywords and pricing.
* Manage **Amazon A\+ Content** and **Brand/Store Pages**.
* Ensure catalogue quality and consistency across platforms.
* Identify and resolve listing, catalogue and marketplace\-related issues.
* Set standards and best practices for new product listings and catalogue maintenance.

**Marketplace Advertising \& Sales Growth**

* Plan, execute and monitor **Amazon/Flipkart marketplace advertising campaigns**.
* Manage **daily advertising budgets/spends** and campaign performance.
* Monitor **ROAS, ACOS, sales, conversions and advertising efficiency**.
* Identify products and categories with sales\-growth opportunities.

**Inventory \& Order Management**

* Track marketplace\-wise, product\-wise and category\-wise sales.
* Monitor **orders, revenue, returns, cancellations, advertising spend and profitability\-related metrics**.
* Analyze product performance and provide actionable insights to management.

**Team \& Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with **e\-commerce executives, warehouse, dispatch, accounts, customer support and management teams**.
* Monitor team activities and ensure tasks are completed on time.
* Establish efficient processes for marketplace operations.
* Take ownership of operational targets and ensure timely execution.

Required Experience \& Skills

* **3–6 years of hands\-on E\-Commerce experience**, preferably with a brand/company.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with Amazon and Flipkart is mandatory.**
* Experience with **Meesho and Shopify** is preferred.
* Experience managing **multiple e\-commerce marketplaces**, not only Shopify.
* Strong experience in **product listing and catalogue management**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Amazon A\+ Content and Brand/Store Pages**.
* Experience in **marketplace advertising and managing daily ad spend**.
* Strong understanding of **sales reports, MIS and marketplace performance**.
* Experience with **inventory management and order processing**.
* Experience handling **returns, RTOs, refunds and marketplace claims**.

* Strong **MS Excel** skills including:

Important – Please Read Before Applying

The candidate should have hands\-on experience across:

**Marketplace Management \+ Product Listing \+ Amazon/Flipkart Panels \+ Marketplace Ads \+ Daily Ad Spend \+ Sales Growth \+ Inventory \+ Orders \+ Returns \+ Claims \+ Payment Reconciliation \+ A\+ Content \+ Store/Brand Pages \+ Sales Reports \+ Excel.**

description:
Product Manager/ Product Lead
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


* Partner with the Data Solutions and the Domain teams to assess and improve Pulse’s own internal processes for building, packaging, and delivering reusable assets.
* Apply BPR discipline internally: identify bottlenecks in how Pulse itself creates, tests, and hardens product frameworks before they reach the point\-solution catalog.
* Translate internal process findings into concrete improvements to the Best Practice Process Framework, shortening the cycle time between “client inputs” and “building reusable assets.”
* Ensure internal readiness — process maturity, documentation, repeatability — keeps pace with the external commitments the point\-solution and advisory motions make to clients.

External: Productized Point\-Solution Delivery


* Build and continuously extend a catalog of standing diagnostic tools, mini\-assessments, and rapid\-response frameworks deployable against a specific customer query without a full transformation program.
* Respond to inbound, bounded customer requests within a defined turnaround SLA, drawing on pre\-built assets rather than starting from bespoke analysis.
* Package findings and recommendations from point\-solution engagements as candidates for the Best Practice Process Framework, feeding reusable IP back into the wider catalog.

External: Proactive AI Advisory \& Transformation


* Proactively identify and reach out to clients where AI could be placed at the center of their operating model, independent of an active point\-solution request.
* Analyze end\-to\-end business processes at a detailed task level; identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, hand\-offs, gaps, and non\-value\-added activities.
* Design future\-state business processes that deliberately allocate work across three modes — AI\-led agentic workflows, AI\-human hybrid collaboration, and human\-led judgment work — matching each task to the mode best suited to it, not defaulting to full automation.
* Design AI\-enabled target operating models, governance structures, and decision frameworks.
* Assess client transformation maturity and facilitate AI readiness assessments.
* Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps, and implementation plans.
* Lead cross\-functional transformation programmes across business, technology, and operations.

* Cycle time from internal learning/insight to a published reusable asset in the Best Practice Process Framework catalog

* Point\-solution turnaround time against defined SLA
* Processes redesigned and standardized
* Adoption of AI\-enabled operating models
